tool.name: pmotools extract_allele_table
tool.description: Extract allele tables from a PMO for tools like dcifer or moire
tool.command: pmotools-python extract_allele_table --file '$input_pmo' --output '$output_table' --delim '$delim' @OVERWRITE@ #if $skip_validation: --skip_validation #end if #if $allele_freqs_output: --allele_freqs_output '$output_freqs' #end if #if $specimen_info_meta_fields: --specimen_info_meta_fields '$specimen_info_meta_fields' #end if #if $library_sample_info_meta_fields: --library_sample_info_meta_fields '$library_sample_info_meta_fields' #end if #if $microhap_fields: --microhap_fields '$microhap_fields' #end if #if $representative_haps_fields: --representative_haps_fields '$representative_haps_fields' #end if --default_base_col_names '$default_base_col_names'

param.name: skip_validation
param.label: Skip PMO validation
param.help: Skip validation of the PMO against the JSON schema

param.name: specimen_info_meta_fields
param.label: Specimen info metadata fields to include
param.help: Comma-separated field names from the specimen table (e.g. collection_date,collection_country)

param.name: library_sample_info_meta_fields
param.label: Library sample info metadata fields to include
param.help: Comma-separated field names from the library sample table

param.name: microhap_fields
param.label: Microhaplotype fields to include
param.help: Comma-separated additional fields from the detected microhaplotype object (e.g. reads,mhap_id)

param.name: representative_haps_fields
param.label: Representative haplotype fields to include
param.help: Comma-separated additional fields from the representative haplotype object

param.name: default_base_col_names
param.label: Default base column names
param.help: Must be exactly 3 comma-separated column names

tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Extract Allele Table**
Extracts an allele table from a PMO file, suitable for downstream analysis with tools such as dcifer or moire. The allele table contains one row per allele per sample, with columns for library sample name, target name, and microhaplotype ID (by default), plus any additional metadata fields requested.
**Input**
- A PMO JSON file (optionally gzipped)
**Options**
- **Delimiter**: Tab or comma for the output table - **Skip validation**: Skip validating the PMO against the JSON schema before extracting - **Allele frequencies output**: Also produce an allele frequency table as a secondary output - **Specimen info metadata fields**: Comma-separated specimen metadata fields to include as columns - **Library sample info metadata fields**: Comma-separated library sample metadata fields to include as columns - **Microhaplotype fields**: Additional fields from the detected microhaplotype object (e.g. reads, mhap_id) - **Representative haplotype fields**: Additional fields from the representative haplotype object - **Default base column names**: The 3 base column names for the output (default: library_sample_name,target_name,mhap_id)
**Output**
- An allele table (tabular) - Optionally, an allele frequency table (tabular)
